title: cyclosorus dimorphus
intro: Cyclosorus dimorphus, commonly known as the Chinese leopards ear fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus dimorphus include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and analgesic effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as arthritis and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
